_note: Advisory budget configuration for the cost dashboard. Values are for awareness only — Claude Max and Codex are flat subscriptions, not metered. Edit thresholds and plan details to match your actual subscriptions.
metered_api_equivalent_note: All $ figures are API-equivalent value computed from public Anthropic per-token rates. They represent compute consumed within your subscription allowance, NOT charges on your credit card or billing statement. Your actual cost is your flat subscription fee.

monthly_targets._note: claude_max_advisory_usd is the rough API-equivalent ceiling assumed for Claude Max. Adjust if your usage pattern changes. combined_advisory_usd = claude_max + codex advisory totals.

alert_thresholds._note: Thresholds are advisory. They compare API-equivalent monthly total against combined_advisory_usd. No automatic action is taken — warnings are informational only.
